cruzamento:
5 September is a calendar day, and that is what the page records. ⭐ FOR THE SECOND DAY RUNNING NO NATIONAL POLL WAS RELEASED, and the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) register shows why: eight national polls are in the field right now, and the scheduled releases run from 06 to 10/Sep. Veritá on 06/Sep, Quaest on 07/Sep, Gerp and Nexus on 08/Sep, Ideia/Canal Meio, Real Time Big Data and PALVER on 09/Sep, and 100 Cidades, PoderData and AtlasIntel on 10/Sep. Two of them have a sample of 5,000, PALVER and AtlasIntel, and they are the largest on the calendar. 📌 Three of those national polls entered the register on Friday, all with releases scheduled for 10/Sep. There are 29 days to the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno).

⚠️ THIS ROUND PUBLISHES NO NEW PRICE FOR THE WINNER BOOK, because the two independent readings AFOS takes eight minutes apart did not confirm within 0.20 of a point in that contract. Its values on this page are still those of the confirmed reading of 04/Sep, 19:53 BRT, and they are marked as such line by line. The other four books confirmed and carry prices from 05/Sep, 13:29 BRT.

⭐ WHAT MOVED TODAY WERE THE POSITION MARKETS AND THE IMPEACHMENT ONE. In the first-round runner-up contract the runner-up rose 2.00pp and reached 89.50%, and only one point in the whole series has ever been above it, the 90.50% of 21/Aug, while the leader gave up 2.25pp and stands at 5.35%. In the third-place one, Augusto Cury gave up 1.60pp to 51.95% and Renan Santos rose 1.00pp to 24.50%. In the Senate majority one, the MDB gave up 1.50pp to 10.75%, with the PL at 82.00%. They are different contracts on the same election, and the panel neither adds nor subtracts them.

🔑 AND THE [SUPREME COURT](/en/glossary#stf) IMPEACHMENT CONTRACT IS THE DAY'S METHOD CASE. On 04/Sep it went out on a single reading, alongside the range it travelled, because two readings eight minutes apart could not agree in a book that was moving too much. On Friday it confirmed on both readings and returned to the normal rule, at 8.65% (vol USD 88 thousand), against the 15.85% published the day before. In the series recorded since 14/Apr the high is 19.30%, set on 04/Sep, and the low is 2.10%, from 08/Jun: today's price sits 10.60pp below a high from the day before yesterday, in a book that has accumulated USD 88 thousand. The panel records the move and attributes no cause to it.
